summary: A scene load repaints only that scene's canvases, and the UI prefab assets two frames later in ONE FindObjectsOfTypeAll<UIBehaviour> pass instead of four; before, it ran the full RepaintAll (eleven whole-memory passes) inside the load's frame, 0.85-2.3 s with a match's prisms alive (B45).
why: B45 lever 3. Same colours reach the same objects; a row built from a not-yet-painted prefab in those two frames is caught by the existing canvas sweep.
